articles.headline: World Cup Daily: Canada beat South Africa; Haaland in NYC; Iran despair
articles.description: The knockout stage has officially begun! The round of 32 at the 2026 World Cup begins with our first match being South Africa against co-hosts Canada in Inglewood, California.

articles.headline: Co-hosts Canada beat South Africa to book 1st last-16 spot
articles.description: Stephen Eustáquio scored in the second minute of second-half stoppage time, and Canada beat South Africa 1-0 on Sunday for its first knockout match victory in a World Cup.

articles.headline: Canada advance to the Round of 16 after defeating South Africa
articles.description: South Africa's World Cup campaign is over after a 92nd-minute strike from Stephen Eustáquio puts Canada through to the Round of 16 to play either the Netherlands or Morocco.

articles.headline: Herrington focused on world cup amid Barcelona interest
articles.description: Socceroos defender Lucas Herrington is not focused on speculation linking him with a move to Spanish giants Barcelona, trying to stay 'present' at the World Cup.
